label: HTTP access
instructions: A 404 alone is not an outage or attack. A bot user-agent or encoded URL alone is not malicious. Use only requests in this chunk.

criteria.normal: Successful HTTP response or routine redirect without suspicious evidence.
criteria.warning: Client error such as isolated 4xx, slow request, or recoverable HTTP issue.
criteria.error: Server-side 5xx response or explicit failure to serve a request.
criteria.security: Explicit exploit attempt, malicious payload, or unauthorized access evidenced by request details.
criteria.other: Unparseable access record or insufficient HTTP context.
